content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages a personal task list","i_want":"to create a new task with a title, a due date and a priority","so_that":"I can record the work I need to do and when it is due","business_description":"Users can add a new task to their personal to-do list. Each task is stored in the persistence database with a unique ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date and Due Date. The form and the backend reject a task with an empty title or a Due Date earlier than its Creation Date. The frontend shows a success state only after the backend has saved the task.","business_value":"Users can capture tasks reliably, with the mandatory fields and date rules enforced at save time, so the task list and reports are built on valid data.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the task creation form is open with a non-empty Title and a Due Date equal to or later than today","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend saves a new task with a unique ID, the Creation Date set to the current date, and the entered fields, and the form shows the message 'Task created'"},{"given":"the task creation form is open with an empty Title","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the request, the task is not saved, and the form shows an error message stating that the title is required"},{"given":"a new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"the user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-09","then":"the backend rejects the task, nothing is saved, and the form shows an error message that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date"},{"given":"the backend returns an error or cannot be reached when the user submits a new task","when":"the request fails","then":"the form shows an error message and does not show the task as created"},{"given":"the task creation form is open","when":"the user selects a priority","then":"only Low, Medium and High can be selected"}],"edge_cases":["Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted, because the rule rejects only dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A Title containing only spaces is treated as empty; the PRD does not say whether whitespace is trimmed, so this is an open question for the team.","The PRD does not state a default Priority or Status for a new task; the story assumes Status starts as Open, which the team must confirm.","The PRD does not state whether Description is optional; this story assumes it is optional. Open question.","The PRD does not state whether Priority and Due Date are mandatory at creation; only the Title is stated as mandatory. Open question.","A backend failure during create must not show the task as created in the list or form (optimistic UI is not allowed).","The Due Date is compared with the Creation Date, which is set by the backend at save time. The PRD does not state the time zone used for the comparison. Open question.","The Completion Date and Last Updated Date fields are listed in other stories and are not part of this story's table."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["A migration creates the new tasks table with the fields ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date and Due Date, and it runs on the existing database.","POST /tasks saves a task only when the Title is non-empty and the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date.","The form shows the success or error message after each create attempt, and no success state is shown before the backend confirms the save.","Open questions on default Status, Priority, Description and whitespace handling are answered and documented in the story.","The QA test suite for task creation passes in CI."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"tasks-table-migration","title":"[BE] Create tasks table with ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"db","description":"Add a new table in the existing persistence database for to-do items. Fields: unique ID, Title, Description, Status (Open, In Progress, Completed), Priority (Low, Medium, High), Creation Date and Due Date. Enforce allowed values for Status and Priority at the database level if the database supports it.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-c55a77b3","R-9675bb49","R-aaf23206","R-c9046f7a","R-576b7e59","R-9fb58566","R-1c2262bc","R-71bdd372"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Migration creates the tasks table with all listed fields and a unique ID.","Migration runs on the existing database and can be rolled back.","Status and Priority allowed values are enforced or documented."]},{"key_slug":"create-task-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add POST /tasks endpoint with title and due date validation","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Expose an endpoint that creates a task. Reject an empty Title and a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date. Set the Creation Date on the server. Return the created task including its ID. The other endpoints required by the PRD (read all, read by ID, update, delete, status change) are delivered by the stories that use them.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-22f28530","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-244669c0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["POST /tasks returns the created task with ID and Creation Date on success.","An empty Title returns a validation error and nothing is saved.","A Due Date earlier than the Creation Date returns a validation error and nothing is saved.","Endpoint is documented with request and response examples."]},{"key_slug":"task-error-responses","title":"[BE] Return simple error responses for invalid input and server or database failures","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Use one simple error format for invalid input, missing mandatory fields, and internal server or database errors on the create endpoint. The format must give a message the frontend can show.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Invalid input and missing Title return a 4xx response with a readable message.","Database failure returns a 5xx response and does not save partial data.","The error format is the same for all create errors and is documented."]},{"key_slug":"task-create-form","title":"[FE] Add task creation form with title, description, priority and due date fields","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Build the create form for tasks with Title, Description, Priority (Low, Medium, High) and Due Date. Show field-level messages for an empty Title and for a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date. Call POST /tasks on submit.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-aaf23206","R-c9046f7a","R-9fb58566","R-71bdd372"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Form has Title, Description, Priority and Due Date inputs.","Priority accepts only Low, Medium and High.","Submitting with an empty Title shows a message and does not call the API.","Form is covered by component tests."]},{"key_slug":"task-create-feedback","title":"[FE] Show success or error message after task creation and wait for backend confirmation","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"After the create request, show a success message only when the backend returns success. On error, show the error message from the backend. Do not show the task as created before the response arrives.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Success message appears only after a successful response.","Error message appears when the request fails or the backend returns an error.","No optimistic success state is shown while the request is pending or after a failure."]},{"key_slug":"task-create-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for task creation rules and feedback","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write the automated tests for task creation: API tests for the title and date rules and for error responses, and end-to-end tests for the form and messages.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-22f28530","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-9dc414dc","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["API tests cover empty title, date earlier than creation date, and a database failure.","End-to-end test covers success message, error message, and no success state on failure.","Test suite runs in CI and passes."]}]}
